name: spare
description: Ask Claude what's using your Mac: CPU, memory, AI agents, idle apps, and processes agents left running.
long_description:
Spare is a free, open-source menu bar app that shows which apps, projects, and AI agents are using your Mac. This extension lets Claude read the same answers through Spare's `spare` command line tool.

Ask things like "what's using my Mac?", "why was it slow this morning?", or "what did my agents leave running?".

Requires the Spare app (https://spareformac.com). Everything is read-only: Claude can't quit or stop anything. Spare covers CPU and memory, not disk space.

spare_cli.title: Spare command line tool (optional)
spare_cli.description: Leave empty to find Spare automatically in Applications, Homebrew, or Spotlight.

tools.name: spare_status
tools.description: CPU, memory, and memory pressure right now

tools.name: spare_list
tools.description: Apps, projects, and AI agents using the most

tools.name: spare_show
tools.description: What one item is and what closing it affects

tools.name: spare_idle
tools.description: Apps left open but unused for 2+ hours

tools.name: spare_leftovers
tools.description: Browser sessions left open by automation

tools.name: spare_recap
tools.description: CPU and memory history: today or this week
